ABOUT THE TEAM

The Consumer Products team at OpenAI builds end-to-end hardware and software systems that bring AI into the physical world. We work at the intersection of custom silicon, embedded systems, operating systems, and cloud services to deliver reliable, production-ready devices at scale.

Within Consumer Products, the camera stack is a critical sensing component. The team partners closely with electrical engineering, silicon vendors, systems, and higher-level perception and product teams to bring up new hardware, stabilize capture pipelines, and ensure camera systems are robust, debuggable, and ready for real-world deployment. This work spans early prototypes through production, with a strong emphasis on correctness, repeatability, and long-term reliability.

ABOUT THE ROLE

As a Camera Firmware Engineer, you will own low-level camera enablement on custom hardware—from early board bring-up through stable production capture. You will develop and maintain the firmware and software that makes camera sensors reliable, controllable, and debuggable, forming the foundation for higher-level camera pipelines and product features.

This role is highly hands-on and systems-oriented. You will work close to the hardware, diagnose real-world timing and integration issues, and build tooling that accelerates iteration across the entire camera stack.

This role is based in San Francisco, CA. We follow a hybrid work model with four days per week in the office and offer relocation assistance to new employees.

IN THIS ROLE, YOU WILL

- Bring up new camera sensors and modules on prototype and production boards, including link stability, sensor control, and correct power, reset, and clock sequencing.

- Develop and maintain low-level camera software, including sensor drivers, board configuration, and camera subsystem integration across hardware revisions.

- Enable and validate core capture paths for development and production, including RAW capture for debugging, still capture, and hardware-accelerated video encode and streaming with stable timestamps and long-duration reliability.

- Stand up camera control and repeatability features, including basic 3A loop exposure, manual overrides and locks, and deterministic presets to support validation and debugging.

- Build and maintain camera bring-up tooling, such as capture scripts, automated sweeps, manifests, and debugging utilities that make issues reproducible and easy to triage.

- Partner closely with electrical engineering, camera pipeline owners, and systems teams to define interfaces, unblock integration, and keep the camera stack stable as the device evolves.

YOU MIGHT THRIVE IN THIS ROLE IF YOU:

- Deep experience shipping embedded camera systems, including sensor bring-up, driver development, and board-level debugging.

- Strong C/C++ experience with embedded or Linux-based systems; comfortable debugging across kernel and userspace boundaries.

- Hands-on understanding of common camera hardware interfaces (for example, MIPI CSI and sensor control buses) and the practical realities of bring-up, including power, reset, clocking, and sequencing.

- Proven track record of building reliable capture paths and effective debug workflows that accelerate iteration through reproducible failures and well-scoped fixes.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

- Experience with common mobile or embedded SoC camera stacks and vendor frameworks.

- Experience integrating and debugging hardware acceleration blocks adjacent to camera pipelines, such as video encode and decode paths.

- Familiarity building higher-level capture pipelines (for example, GStreamer) on top of low-level camera enablement.

jobs.description: At Amazon, we're dedicated to becoming the most customer-centric company on Earth. To achieve this goal, we seek exceptionally talented, bright, and driven individuals. Amazon is currently looking for a Safety Investigations Analyst to join Middle Mile Investigations (MMI) within NAST Safety and Compliance. The Safety Investigations Analyst owns investigation of Middle Mile transportation incidents end to end, from intake through documented finding, across Amazon's carrier programs: Relay Motor Carrier (RMC), Relay Motor Carrier LineHaul (RMCLH), Relay Motor Carrier Box Truck (RMCBT), and Amazon Freight Partner (AFP). In this role you will conduct comprehensive incident investigations using telematics, video, and law enforcement records; apply FMCSA Crash Preventability Determination Program criteria; identify trends across regions, programs, and carriers; recommend enforcement action under published authority matrices; and serve as incident point of contact to internal stakeholders and external counsel. Findings inform network-level changes intended to reduce incident frequency and severity. The successful candidate writes clearly for senior audiences, reaches defensible conclusions from incomplete information, and works independently across competing deadlines. Key job responsibilities Investigation - Own assigned incident investigations end to end, from intake through documented finding, across RMC, RMCLH, RMCBT, and AFP. - Collect and preserve evidence including telematics, dash camera footage, law enforcement records, and carrier documentation. - Apply FMCSA Crash Preventability Determination Program criteria and video review standards. - Write investigation narratives documenting what occurred and the factors identified, each sourced to verifiable data. - Serve as incident point of contact to internal stakeholders and, when assigned, external counsel. Analysis and enforcement - Identify trends across regions, carrier programs, and individual carriers, and surface them to the Program Manager. - Recommend enforcement action under published authority matrices. - Query multiple data systems to extract and reconcile investigation data. Operating rhythm - Maintain case records and queue status in the systems of record, keeping tracking current and auditable. - Review recurring vendor investigation reports for completeness, and escalate vendor performance issues. - Report investigation status, closure metrics, and case aging to the Program Manager on a recurring cadence. - Propose improvements to investigation process and standard work. A day in the life Your morning starts with the queue: new incidents overnight, open evidence requests, cases aging. You pull telematics and video on an assigned collision and chase the law enforcement report and carrier documentation. By afternoon you are writing the narrative, sourcing every line. Some events bring outside counsel into the file, and you are the person who knows what happened. A pattern you flagged last month across two regions becomes a recommendation your Program Manager takes to an enforcement decision. No two investigations are the same, and what you document today shapes what the network changes next quarter. About the team Middle Mile Investigations (MMI) sits within NAST Safety and Compliance. We investigate transportation incidents across Amazon's Middle Mile carrier programs, document what happened from verifiable evidence, and surface patterns that inform how the network operates. The team is small and geographically distributed. Analysts own their cases rather than a shared queue, and the written product carries to senior leaders who act on it. We are building our standard work now, so you will help shape how this function operates rather than inherit a finished process. If you want ownership and are comfortable with ambiguity, you will do well here.

jobs.description: Become a part of our caring community The Senior Product Engineer helps decide what we build, not just how we build it. This is a senior engineering role at its foundation. You design, develop, and deploy scalable web applications end to end, and you meet a high bar for engineering craft. You also own the product: you shape what we build, influence what goes on the roadmap, and are measured by the outcomes your work produces rather than the tickets you close. You explore before you commit, propose the work as often as you receive it, and sharpen requirements rather than simply implement them. You will build accessible user interfaces, implement robust back-end microservices, and integrate the two with GraphQL, all while exercising considerable latitude over technical approach. Strong product instinct here does not lower the engineering bar; it raises the overall one. How We Work We work in an agent-accelerated, skills-driven engineering practice. Our engineers use AI coding tools like Claude Code as a core part of daily development. They also build and maintain the shared skills and tooling that make that workflow effective, rather than only consuming what someone else set up. You will extend your environment, not just operate inside it. This is an emerging practice, not a settled playbook. The line between product and engineering is blurring, and on this team you will help establish how that works rather than inherit a finished process. If building a new way of working sounds like the reason to take the job rather than a source of uncertainty, you are the person we are looking for. Set and pursue the outcomes that matter for the products you own. Explore before committing: Run discovery, spikes, and prototypes to test whether something is the right thing to build before investing in a full implementation Stay close to the problem: Engage directly with users and stakeholders to understand the problems behind the requests, when access to them allows; carry what you learn back into the work End-to-end delivery: Independently design, develop, and deploy full-stack applications, including accessible UIs, GraphQL APIs, and Node.js-based microservices, ensuring seamless integration across all layers Accessible UI development: Build responsive, WCAG 2.2-compliant user interfaces with accessibility as a first-class concern, including semantic HTML, ARIA, keyboard navigation, and screen reader testing Performance and security: Optimize application performance (e.g., lazy loading, code splitting, query complexity analysis) and implement security best practices (e.g., OAuth2, JWT, input validation) Test-driven development: Follow TDD principles to write comprehensive unit, integration, and end-to-end tests. jobs.description: IMDb is the world's most popular source for movie, TV, and celebrity content, reaching an audience of more than 250 million unique visitors per month. We're looking for a Senior Policy Program Manager to join IMDb's Content Operations team and own the full lifecycle of content policy — from creation and versioning through to enforcement and machine-interpretability. In this role, you'll be the dedicated owner of IMDb's policy framework, ensuring that our policies are clearly authored, properly versioned, consistently enforced, and structured for machine consumption by our automated moderation systems. You'll define and maintain the policy store and tag definitions that power IMDb's multi-layered moderation architecture. This role requires someone who can navigate ambiguity, drive cross-functional alignment across Product, Engineering, Legal, PR, and Operations, and deliver measurable improvements to policy coverage and enforcement accuracy at scale. The most successful candidate will think strategically about how policy decisions impact hundreds of millions of users, while diving deep into the technical details of how policies are codified and interpreted by automated systems. Key job responsibilities • Own end-to-end policy creation, versioning, publication, and deprecation across IMDb's content ecosystem, managing the full lifecycle from identification of need through stakeholder sign-off to implementation. • Design and maintain the policy store authoring framework and tags that enables policies to be machine-readable and enforceable by automated moderation systems. • Drive cross-functional collaboration with Product Management, Engineering, Legal, PR, Risk Management, and Operations to ensure policies are comprehensive, compliant, and implementable. • Define program strategy for policy governance, including prioritization frameworks, SLA tracking, and metrics to measure policy effectiveness and enforcement accuracy. • Present policy risks, recommendations, and program updates to Directors and VPs, building consensus across discordant views and securing resources for policy initiatives. • Identify and drive process improvements to streamline policy workflows, reduce time-to-enforcement, and eliminate redundant or conflicting policies across the organization. • Identify new trends in the entertainment industry and develop new policies to support them. • Mentor and develop team members, actively contributing to hiring and raising the bar on policy program management practices A day in the life You'll start your day reviewing policy effectiveness metrics and enforcement signals, identifying where gaps or inconsistencies exist between policy intent and automated enforcement. You'll regularly present to senior leadership on policy program health, upcoming changes, and strategic direction.

This individual will be the connective tissue between Global Logistics (GL) business teams and IT — translating logistics business processes into a scalable solution design, owning the architecture end to end, and leading the organizational change required to adopt it.

• Roadmap contribution — support the broader SCT roadmap, including EDI stabilization, RFID, and AI-driven automation initiatives.

• Proven, hands-on experience rolling out a TMS solution end to end — from design through go-live and stabilization — not solely supporting an existing system.

회사 소개
쿠팡은 고객 감동 실현을 위해 존재합니다. 고객들이 "쿠팡 없이 그동안 어떻게 살았을까?" 라고 말할 때, 비로소 우리의 미션을 실현하고 있음을 알 수 있습니다. 고객들의 쇼핑과 식사, 생활 전반을 편하게 만들겠다는 유일한 집념으로 쿠팡은 수억 달러 규모의 이커머스 산업 전반의 혁신을 이끌고 있습니다. 쿠팡은 가장 빠르게 성장하는 이커머스 기업 중 하나로, 국내 커머스 업계에서의 독보적인 입지와, 고객 신뢰를 구축했습니다.
쿠팡은 스타트업 문화를 기반으로 한 글로벌 대형 상장사라고 자부합니다. 이것이 창립 당시의 기민함을 지하며, 신규 서비스를 끊임없이 출시하며 비즈니스를 확장해 나가는 우리의 성장 동력입니다. 쿠팡의 모든 임직원에게는 기업가 정신을 갖추고 새로운 혁신과 이니셔티브를 추진할 수 있는 기회가 주어집니다. 주저 없이 일에 뛰어들어 성과를 이루고자 하는 과감성이, 바로 쿠팡이 일하는 방식의 본질입니다. 쿠팡에서는 여러분 자신, 동료, 팀 그리고 회사 전체가 매일 성장하는 모습을 목격할 것입니다.
쿠팡의 모든 직원은 커머스의 미래를 만들겠다는 쿠팡의 미션에 진심입니다. 우리는 고객의 문제를 해결해 나가고, 전통적인 관념과 통념에 맞서며 실현 가능한 한계를 뛰어넘고 있습니다. 고가용성 (always-on) 과 최첨단의 앞선 기술 (high-tech), 초연결사회 (hyper-connected world) 에서의 놀라운 업무 경험을 원하신다면, 지금 바로 쿠팡에 합류하세요.

본 포지션은 글로벌 3개국 사이트에서 운영되는 500명 규모 조직의
